paragraphs.text: Grismold , the Dreadsower is a legendary troll shaman from an unknown plane .

Deep in the forests of his plane, Grismold has formed a symbiotic relationship with the strange, carnivorous plants that live among the primordial trees. They feast on the corpses he brings back for them, and he feasts on their nectar - an unusually rich, invigorating source of nutrients.
